In this lesson, you will determine if a FET amplifier circuit is faulted and if so, what the fault is.
INTRODUCTIONM
You will practice troubleshooting a FET amplifier for many typical faults that commonly occur.
Measuring and comparing the input to the output quickly determines if the circuit is operating correctly.
Signal tracing can identify many faulted components.
A faulted FET can be confirmed by measuring the resistance of the junctions between the gate to source and gate to drain.

The purpose of this experiment is to give you practice in determining if a FET amplifier circuit is operating normally. If the circuit is faulted, you will determine the faulty component and verify correct operation when the computer repairs the circuit.
